deviations.description: cross-env@10.1.0 added (not in WI pin list). Required because the POSIX VAR=x npm script syntax fails on Windows cmd.exe. Engines >=20 verified.
styled-components resolved to 6.1.19 (pin was ^6.1.13, now ~6.1.13 to stay within 6.1.x). 6.1.19 is within the 6.1.x patch band.
deviations.impact: none — patch-level update within the stated major.minor

deviations.description: @playwright/test@1.48.2 resolves Chromium revision 1140, not 1243 as stated in the WI. The WI claimed 'Chromium build 1243 → @playwright/test 1.48.2' but the installed browsers.json for 1.48.2 specifies revision 1140. B11 must re-verify the correct Playwright version for revision 1243 before running E2E.
deviations.impact: E2E tests (B11) may download a different browser or fail if Chromium 1243 is assumed. The vitest-only B1/B2 scope is unaffected.

deviations.description: Single tsconfig.json instead of the Vite-recommended two-project (app + node) references split. Removed tsconfig.node.json to avoid TS6306 'composite: true' error. All includes (src, vite.config.ts, vitest.config.ts, eslint.config.js) are in one tsconfig with 'files': ['src/shared/theme/theme.d.ts'] for styled-components module augmentation.
deviations.impact: Minor: no separate type-checking of build tool config files; covered by 'include' array instead

deviations.description: For client.test.ts and locales.parity.test.ts the implementation was written before the tests (code-first). loginSchema.test.ts went RED-GREEN-REFACTOR correctly. LoginPage.test.tsx success test (D5) was added after implementation was complete — test passed immediately without a prior RED cycle.
deviations.impact: TDD discipline gap on B1 scaffolding; all tests pass correctly

deviations.description: React Router v7 future flag warnings appear in console (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath). The flags exist on MemoryRouter in test context but not on createBrowserRouter TypeScript types in react-router-dom 6.x. Warnings are non-blocking and will resolve when migrating to React Router v7 in a future WI.
